scope: Execute the officially preprocessed FieldMarks sketch's settings/setup/draw and S-key handler in actual JAVA2D. A validation subclass invokes the save handler and exits after the first frame; no drawing logic is replaced.
configuration: Unchanged FieldMarks.pde defaults: seed42, 640x640 JAVA2D density1, 25600 marks, maxLength16, original palette, line marks.
acceptance: Assert native JAVA2D, dimensions/density, retained count and default settings; invoke actual S-key handler; require one readable 640x640 PNG; inspect the resulting mark field. No exact raster match threshold.
